correctness.rationale: The independent attacking-copy score is exactly Q(r,d)=r²+rd+d²/3 via two defending draws and uniform tie-breaking. Exchangeable self-play gives sum_j D_j F_j(D)=1/3 and hence the minimax threshold. Q is positive-definite quadratic, yielding strict convexity in any varying supported coordinate and uniqueness. If the strict Condorcet middle B is excluded, pure A or C fails and both extremes must be supported. Their scores, from all four rankings, force t=D_A=3(u+m)-1 and 1/3<s=u+m<2/3; the last unsaturated F_B condition is exactly m+n+u(2-3s)²+v(3s-1)²<=1/3. Conversely the same inequalities give F_A=F_C=1/3 and F_B<=1/3, enough for unique stability. Exact algebra proves three symmetric regimes and endpoints. An independently coded exact rational evaluator checked 1,130 finite four-ranking profiles plus five symmetric boundaries; this is corroboration, not proof of all weights.
